Markers

Shape carries the meaning; colour is a second signal. Each marker is an inline SVG symbol with a paper halo and an ink line so it reads on light and dark floors. Open #grey to see the whole page in greyscale.

Conversation

Shape: Speech bubble. A coworker has something to say. Coral.

Over a person's head. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Terminal

Shape: Monitor. A device you can use. Teal.

On or above the device. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Route

Shape: Diamond with a doorway. A path that is open or newly open. Gold.

At the door or shortcut. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Glitch

Shape: Folded page. A repair duel. Violet, glitches only.

Above the glitch. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Keycap states

Keycaps are DOM components. A held key is teal, sits lower and carries the word "Hold", so no state depends on colour alone.
